basis: Pinned Excalidraw v0.18.1 source inspected before investigator execution
scoringUnit: One factual responsibility or relationship; literal source filename recovery is not required when equivalent bundle evidence supports the fact.

ratings.FULL: Correctly explains the factual statement and its material relationship or behavior with retained evidence from that arm's permitted inputs; no material contradiction.
ratings.PARTIAL: Correctly identifies a material part but omits or weakens an essential relationship, boundary or condition; evidence supports the part actually claimed.
ratings.INCORRECT: Makes a material factual claim contradicted by the pinned source or wrongly assigns ownership, flow or behavior. Unsupported certainty is not upgraded to correctness by plausible wording.
ratings.UNKNOWN: The arm explicitly leaves the fact unresolved or omits it. Do not infer knowledge from generic adjacent prose.
ratings.NOT_OBSERVABLE: Evaluator determines the fact cannot reasonably be recovered from this arm's frozen allowed artifact and documented capabilities. Must include a concrete reason; not a substitute for an arm's failure to investigate. Exclude from an accuracy denominator only under a declared common comparison policy.

evaluationPolicy.noRetrofit: Freeze facts and definitions before blind-arm outputs; do not alter expected statements in response to an arm's answer.
evaluationPolicy.traceabilitySeparate: Record factual rating and evidence traceability independently; a correct statement without trace cannot prove tool capability.
evaluationPolicy.denominator: Report FULL, PARTIAL, INCORRECT, UNKNOWN and NOT_OBSERVABLE counts separately; do not invent a weighted percentage.
evaluationPolicy.sameInputs: Apply the same factual rubric to all arms and retain justified observability differences.

facts.expected: The application wrapper renders the reusable Excalidraw component and supplies an onChange callback that initiates local persistence.
The core App component constructs Scene, Store and History as separate collaborating objects.
facts.anchor: this.scene = new Scene(); this.store = new Store(); this.history = new History()

facts.expected: Canvas pointer down, move and up handlers in the core App coordinate drawing and editing transitions.
Scene owns and exposes the scene's element collections used by interaction and rendering.
The SHAPES registry maps tool kinds such as rectangle, ellipse, arrow, line, freedraw and text to icons and keyboard shortcuts.
Actions renders shape-selection radio controls from the registry and forwards the selected tool into the application's active tool state.
The interactive canvas is a distinct canvas layer receiving pointer events and rendering transient interaction and selection state.
The static canvas is separated from the interactive canvas for rendering scene content.
Text editing uses a DOM textarea rather than requiring direct editing of rasterized canvas text.
Named property actions transform element style and application drawing properties through the action mechanism.
Duplicate selection is a named action supporting Ctrl/Cmd+D and captures the resulting scene change immediately.
Deletion is a selection-aware named action with capture timing based on whether a scene selection exists.
History records inverse nonempty changes onto an undo stack and maintains a separate redo stack.
Recording a nonempty element change clears redo, while a change limited to application state such as unselection does not clear redo.
Undo and redo apply history entries, move changes to the opposite stack and continue past entries that cause no visible change.
Undo and redo UI actions call the History object with Store snapshot context, and their buttons reflect whether their stacks are empty.
LocalData debounces scene and app-state persistence and separately saves attached files through its fileStorage manager.
The configured local persistence debounce is 300 ms, with element and app-state storage keys excalidraw and excalidraw-state.
LocalData pauses saving when the document is hidden or its collaboration-related saving lock is held.
Image file data is held in IndexedDB rather than only in the localStorage element JSON.

Startup reads and parses element and app-state storage separately, catches malformed JSON, defaults elements to an empty array and app state to null, and preserves whichever component parsed successfully.
Browser, local export and server app-state representations use separate field-whitelist policies; scroll, zoom and selection may persist in browser state without being exported.
Element clearing for localStorage and JSON export removes deleted elements and clears lastCommittedPoint on linear elements.
Local scene JSON contains type, version, source, filtered elements, export-whitelisted app state and files referenced by nondeleted elements; database serialization omits files.
Import parses scene data, validates the top-level Excalidraw type and element-array shape, then delegates migration and binding repair to restore.
The loadScene action preserves existing elements and files on invalid import and sets an error message; user cancellation via AbortError is handled separately.
facts.anchor: actionLoadScene; error.name AbortError; elements; errorMessage; files app.files

facts.expected: The image export dialog lets the user select export-only-selected, background, dark mode, scene embedding and output scale before invoking PNG or SVG export.
facts.anchor: exportOnlySelected; exportBackgroundSwitch; exportDarkModeSwitch; exportEmbedSwitch; exportScale; onExportImage

facts.expected: exportCanvas rejects an empty element list and branches into distinct SVG and canvas/PNG pipelines, delegating actual saving to filesystem helpers.
SVG export creates an SVG root with scene-derived viewBox and scaled dimensions, optional background and metadata, with encoded scene payload support for editable exports.
facts.anchor: exportToSvg; getCanvasSize; viewBox; exportScale; encodeSvgBase64Payload; decodeSvgBase64Payload

facts.expected: PNG export renders a temporary canvas into a PNG blob and, when scene embedding is enabled, augments that blob with serialized scene metadata before saving with the editable export extension.
